transformations.summary: Selected REPORDER 2023, retained FED_NUM, ED_NAMEE, ED_NAMEF and REPORDER, appended checksum-bound lineage fields, and retained every source polygon without dissolve, simplify, repair, clipping or reprojection.

plainLanguageExplanation.en: Official federal electoral district boundaries under the 2023 Representation Orders, used as boundary context only.
plainLanguageExplanation.fr: Limites officielles des circonscriptions électorales fédérales selon les décrets de représentation de 2023, utilisées uniquement comme contexte territorial.

nextExpectedRefresh.reason: Elections Canada publishes boundary editions as required and does not provide a fixed next-release date; recheck the official listing before each Witness Tree release.

modificationNotice: Witness Tree selected only REPORDER 2023 fields and appended lineage fields. Source geometries and named publisher attributes were not altered.
limits: The artifact is federal electoral boundary context, not an electoral result, electorate, demographic, representation, Indigenous-rights, or traditional-territory dataset.
The edition is the 2023 Representation Orders used for the 45th general election; it is not claimed current beyond that named edition.
A separate French publisher archive remains an open acquisition checkpoint even though this admitted layer contains both ED_NAMEE and ED_NAMEF.
